impact.text: Performance-fee logic, NAV reporting and integrations relying on share price are wrong.

precondition_sources.text: The HypoVault constructor pre-sets totalSupply to 1 000 000.
At that point the vault owns zero underlying assets.
Before the first fulfilment computeNAV() equals assetsDeposited, so totalAssets equals 1.

intent_sources.text: The vault should start with zero share supply and mint shares only when assets exist.
